instruction: Glitch has been after Rogue's data shard all night. Get it into his hands.

target.reason: The end state (glitch holds data-shard) is reachable only if rogue offers the shard and glitch accepts, but rogue's stance toward glitch is wary tolerance while he weighs whether glitch is worth the heat; nothing in the instruction or the page gives glitch a way to induce rogue to hand over the shard, so no ordered action list above carries the instruction out.
